name: acid-prophet
description: Codebase-grounded discovery, behavioral spec review, and executable planning for Codex with stable acceptance traceability and optional Linear handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Turn raw ideas into reviewed specs
interface.longDescription: Acid Prophet turns feature requests into reviewed specs and implementation plans. Trace the existing code before asking consequential questions, resolve reversible technical choices within delegated authority, and review one coherent proposal. The independent auditor checks behavioral consistency, observable acceptance, justified boundaries, and repository evidence. Stable AC ids connect specs, deliverables, necessary contracts, quickstart scenarios, Linear issues, checklists, and drift findings. Incomplete or contradictory audit reports cannot authorize handoff. Project constitutions add governing constraints.
defaultPrompt: Use Acid Prophet to turn this feature idea into a reviewed spec.
Use Acid Prophet to structure this project before creating Linear work.
